title: Compass and Letter
author: Ulyana Underhill
blurb: Mara Dunmore, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
